output.summary: Large tree native to coastal rainforests of New South Wales and Queensland in eastern Australia. It has exceptionally large leaves, rusty-haired new growth and yellow-orange fruit containing fleshy orange coverings around the seeds. These coverings have an acidic flavour and are eaten raw or made into preserves, sauces, chutneys and cordials.
output.edibilityNote: The orange fleshy seed coverings are eaten raw and used for jams, jellies, sauces, chutneys and cordials.
